description: H205F22 W1 parameterless untrusted transport capture of EC2 IID document+rsa2048 via IMDSv2. No identity, reboot, persistence or canonical authority.

runCommand:
set -eu
umask 077
TMPDIR_W1="$(mktemp -d /tmp/metaengine-w1-iid.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMPDIR_W1"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
python3 - "$TMPDIR_W1/envelope.json" <<'PY'
import base64,hashlib,http.client,json,sys
HOST='169.254.169.254'
PORT=80
TIMEOUT=2.0
def fetch(method,path,headers,limit):
    c=http.client.HTTPConnection(HOST,PORT,timeout=TIMEOUT)
    try:
        c.request(method,path,body=None,headers=headers)
        r=c.getresponse()
        if r.status != 200:
            raise RuntimeError('imds_http_status:%s' % r.status)
        b=r.read(limit+1)
        if not b or len(b)>limit:
            raise RuntimeError('imds_payload_size_invalid')
        return b
    finally:
        c.close()
token=fetch('PUT','/latest/api/token',{'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds':'60'},4096)
try:
    token_text=token.decode('ascii')
except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
    raise RuntimeError('imds_token_not_ascii') from exc
if token_text.strip()!=token_text or any(ord(ch)<33 or ord(ch)>126 for ch in token_text):
    raise RuntimeError('imds_token_invalid')
headers={'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token':token_text}
document=fetch('GET','/latest/dynamic/instance-identity/document',headers,16384)
rsa2048=fetch('GET','/latest/dynamic/instance-identity/rsa2048',headers,32768)
out={'schema':'metaengine.compute.w1-aws-iid-courier.h205f22.v1','source':'HOST_UNTRUSTED_TRANSPORT','transport':'AWS_IMDSV2_LINK_LOCAL_IPV4','document_base64':base64.b64encode(document).decode('ascii'),'document_sha256':hashlib.sha256(document).hexdigest(),'rsa2048_base64':base64.b64encode(rsa2048).decode('ascii'),'rsa2048_transport_sha256':hashlib.sha256(rsa2048).hexdigest(),"provider_identity_verified":False,"reboot_completion_proven":False,"persistent_worker_proof":False,"w1_verified":False,"canonical":False,"authority_effect":False}
with open(sys.argv[1],'w',encoding='utf-8') as h:
    h.write(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
PY
cat "$TMPDIR_W1/envelope.json"
